verdict.rationale: MX publishes an official OpenAPI specification for its Platform API, including a GitHub repo. Its docs direct users to import that spec into Postman to explore request and response payloads, backed by free developer API keys and test institutions. The runnable, interactive part comes from Postman, a third-party tool, not from an MX-hosted reference. Missing for 10: a first-party interactive API reference, in-docs runnable examples or try-it consoles, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
